scripts.build:dev: tsc -b && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }" && vite build --mode development && npm run copy-webxml
scripts.build:uat: tsc -b && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }" && vite build --mode uat && npm run copy-webxml
scripts.build: tsc -b && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force dist }" && vite build --mode production && npm run copy-webxml
scripts.war:dev: npm run build:dev && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist\* -DestinationPath app.zip -Force; Rename-Item app.zip app.war -Force"
scripts.war:uat: npm run build:uat && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist\* -DestinationPath app.zip -Force; Rename-Item app.zip app.war -Force"
scripts.war: npm run build && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist\* -DestinationPath app.zip -Force; Rename-Item app.zip app.war -Force"
scripts.copy-webxml: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist\WEB-INF; Copy-Item -Path deploy-resources\WEB-INF\* -Destination dist\WEB-INF -Recurse -Force"
